verification_note: Reconciled all 82 detailed English outline bullets in both directions, preserving source order within each domain (15/17/24/13/13). Each locator uses unique heading excerpts and an exact short bullet anchor; every bullet has one objective. Explicit compound operations are split; derived=true marks instructional decomposition beyond explicitly named components. Weights match the detailed guide. Effective scope: April 17, 2026; no future effective outline was found. Certification page offers scheduling as checked on 2026-10-04. Additional derived detail: d2-o02-s03 through s05 map to sas-overview > Types of shared access signatures; d2-o03-s02 and s03 map to stored-policy > introductory limitations and Modify or revoke a stored access policy; d4-o02-s02 maps to gateway-transit > hub/spoke configuration and PowerShell; d4-o02-s03 maps to peering-settings > Create a virtual network peering > forwarded traffic options. The old storage/common/storage-stored-access-policy URL returned 404; the authoritative REST reference in sources was successfully retrieved instead. Current SAS overview lists user-delegation support beyond Blob Storage, so historical blob-only answers need separate review rather than automatic credit. No historical answer provenance or scoring was verified here. Verification covers published scope and the cited supplemental distinctions, not exhaustive product behavior or unpublished exam content; localized update timing can differ.
